title: 导航系统异常
description: 导航系统存在错误，如目标追踪导致飞船飞向错误方向或传送至随机星系，影响正常导航。
evidence: if you place a target anywhere but a set item like a ship yourself another NPC ship or a station it flys off to the left and if you have target tracking takes your ass with it also I don't know if it's a bug or an intended feature but if you have target tracking set to on and you exit the nav console it takes you to the center of a random solar system

evidence_items.quote: if you place a target anywhere but a set item like a ship yourself another NPC ship or a station it flys off to the left and if you have target tracking takes your ass with it also I don't know if it's a bug or an intended feature but if you have target tracking set to on and you exit the nav console it takes you to the center of a random solar system
evidence_items.description: 导航系统异常，目标追踪导致飞船飞向错误方向或传送至随机星系
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你把目标放在任何地方，而不是像飞船、你自己、另一艘NPC飞船或空间站这样的固定物体上，它就会向左飞走，如果你开启了目标追踪，它还会把你一起带走。另外，我不知道这是个bug还是有意设计的功能，但如果你把目标追踪设为开启，然后退出导航控制台，它会把你带到某个随机太阳系的中心。
